tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily lowest/average UK price for one product over a trailing window, plus summary stats (historical low with date, high, trend direction). Optionally scoped to a variant configuration; if the variant series is too thin the backend falls back to product-level history (see scope field).

tools.name: get_market_deals
tools.description: Current best-value products across the UK market: largest verified price spreads between retailers (3+ retailers, false-positive filters applied). Good for "what are the best golf deals right now?". Follow up with get_product_offers for purchase links.

tools.name: get_catalog_stats
tools.description: Live catalogue totals plus the valid values for search filters (brands, product types, conditions, flexes, hands, price range). Call this before filtered searches if unsure which brand or product_type spellings the catalogue uses.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_golf_products" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: query, brand, product_type, condition, min_price, max_price, on_sale, sort_by, limit, offset, context

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_product_offers" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Tool "get_catalog_stats" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_offers, check_deal_link · Private data: check_deal_link · Public sink: check_deal_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_offers, check_deal_link · Private data: check_deal_link · Public sink: check_deal_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
